Explore our curated list of practical breathing guides—there's bound to be one that works for you tonight.

items.title: The 4-7-8 Breathing Method: The 1-Minute Tranquilizer
items.description: Highly recommended by Harvard experts as a pre-sleep physical intervention. Activate your parasympathetic nervous system by extending your exhalations.

items.title: Box Breathing: The Ultimate Savior for Severe Pre-sleep Anxiety
items.description: The exact rhythmic breathing used by Navy SEALs to instantly clear a racing mind in high-stress situations.

items.question: Which breathing method should I try first?
items.answer: If you can't sleep because your heart is racing, start with the 4-7-8 method to physically lower your heart rate. If you can't sleep because you are constantly overthinking (rumination), try Box Breathing to force your attention away.

items.question: Do I absolutely need an app?
items.answer: You can count mentally, but doing so with your eyes closed often makes you lose the rhythm and increases anxiety. The BreathWave Apple Watch haptic guide works through pure vibration, letting your brain completely shut off.

cta.title: Ready for a good night's sleep?
cta.description: Pick your pace, follow the haptic rhythm on your wrist, and drift away.
